scenes.big: Why is the road so blinding?
scenes.en: It's not just sunlight. It's glare.
scenes.say: Why does the road look so blinding at noon? It's not just sunlight. It's glare.

scenes.en: Light bouncing off roads, water and car glass turns into flat, harsh glare.
scenes.ta: சாலை, தண்ணீர், கார் கண்ணாடியில் ஒளி பிரதிபலிக்கும்
scenes.say: When sunlight bounces off a flat road, water, or a car windscreen, it becomes harsh glare. That makes you squint, and tires your eyes.

scenes.en: A special filter blocks that flat glare. Everything looks clearer.
scenes.say: Polarised lenses have a special filter that blocks this glare. Roads, water and the sky look clearer and calmer.

scenes.en: A child's eye lens is clearer, so more UV light gets inside.
scenes.ta: குழந்தைகளின் கண்களில் அதிக UV ஒளி செல்லும்
scenes.say: Did you know? A child's eye lens is clearer than an adult's, so more UV light reaches deep inside. Kids need sun protection too.
